We raised our price from $49 to $340 a month on a Tuesday and told nobody.

Churn that month: 2 accounts out of 212. Both had been paying with a card that expired in March.

I had spent eleven weeks preparing for this. A deck and a three-paragraph email with a founder's signature at the bottom, which our head of support rewrote twice because it "sounded like a hostage note."

Nobody read the email. We know because the tracking pixel fired 31 times and 19 of those were me.

The reason is that 140 of the 212 accounts are expensed on a company card by someone who left in 2024, and the card keeps working.

Our enterprise tier is a company card nobody has cancelled yet.
